text.tspan: Password reset uses an email code before the new-password form.
"(proposed)" = the step is not in the code today.
US 5.0.2 Reset a forgotten password (no Admin step, AT 4)
Google-only and Microsoft-only accounts reset through their provider.
Sign-out runs in the browser. There is no /auth/signout route as of October 11, 2026.
SignedOutGuard sends a page that the Back button restores to /login (AT 2).
A server-side sign-out route and Cache-Control no-store are still proposed.

svg.text: For an email account, call signInWithOtp
Send email with a verification code (AT 1)
Generic response: if an account exists, a code is on its way
Show error. Offer a new email
Set session cookies and confirm verification
Password changed. Old password stops working
Show success and Back to Login
Select Logout in HeaderDropdown or AdminNavBar,
or Sign Out on the "Awaiting Admin Approval" screen (AT 3)
Stay on the page. Show "Sign-out failed.
Check your connection and try again." (exists)
Session ended. Browser auth cookies cleared
Press Back, or open the app again (AT 1, AT 2)
Request a signed-in page. Page is not cached
US 5.0.2, 5.0.4: Reset a Forgotten Password / Sign Out Properly
